description: This file contains helper functions for parsing environment variables, specifically for environment configuration in a React application built with Create React App (CRA). It provides functions to retrieve base URLs, healthcheck paths, parse JSON environment variables, and manage feature flags and experiments flags.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the backend base URL for REST API calls, considering environment variables REACT_APP_API_BASE and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, defaults to empty string, and removes trailing slashes.

methods.name: getWsBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket URL from environment variable REACT_APP_WS_URL, or empty string if not set, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: getHealthcheckPath()
methods.description: Returns the healthcheck endpoint path, defaulting to '/healthz'.

methods.name: parseJsonEnv(envValue, fallbackValue)
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string from environment variables, with fallback value on parse failure.

methods.name: getFeatureFlags()
methods.description: Retrieves feature flags as a JSON object from REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS environment variable.

methods.name: experimentsEnabled()
methods.description: Determines if experiments are enabled based on the REACT_APP_EXPERIMENTS_ENABLED environment variable, supporting boolean, numeric, and JSON object formats.

methods.name: isFlagEnabled(flagName, defaultValue = false)
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature flag is enabled in REACT_APP_FEATURE_FLAGS, with a default fallback.
